foil: the SHIPPED E7.12-slice-1 configuration per metric (learner + weight_col held fixed)

null_analysis.binding_constraint: the deflation gates — at least one arm would ship without them

leaderboard.note: ⭐ THE TEXTBOOK FIX — a penalized per-player intercept. PRE-REGISTERED TO LOSE: with a label constant within a player it absorbs the between-player variation and leaves the fixed effects identified by within-player contrasts alone. Run as a DECOMPOSITION, not a hopeful.
P3 + P1 — do the two corrections compose, or is one redundant given the other?
⭐ THE DIRECT-LEARNED FOIL — the shipped E7.12-slice-1 configuration; each row an independent observation, the arm's own shipped weight_col retained
BYTE NO-OP — a constant weight column. Its MAE gap to the foil must be EXACTLY 0; anything else means the harness changed something it did not declare.
MATCHED PARTNER to P1 — the classic half-measure. '1/n over-corrects' is a separate hypothesis from '1/n is right', and a field carrying only one of them cannot tell them apart.
the trajectory delta permuted across players within a level — catches 'any dispersed extra regressor helps' rather than the ordering carrying information.

MATCHED FOIL FOR THE LADDER'S CONTRIBUTION — the same delta computed on RAW rates, which confounds 'the player improved' with 'the level got harder'. If it ties T1, the ladder adds nothing here either.

⭐ FULL DE-PSEUDO-REPLICATION — the observation weight is divided by the player's row count so every PLAYER carries equal total weight. Multiplies the foil's own weight rather than replacing it, so a pitcher arm does not silently drop its shipped `w:mlb_pa`.
⭐ GENUINELY NEW INFORMATION — the ladder-adjusted rate change from the player's previous level, as a fixed regressor (+ an impute flag). NESTS THE FOIL at coefficient 0.
years-at-level + levels-logged — repeating a level is a scouting-legible negative signal the aggregated box line erases (two identical Double-A lines, one taking three seasons).
DEGENERATE CEILING (NF-D11/NF-D14) — predict the population mean of the target.

⭐ THE SHARPEST TEST IN THE SLICE — the row→player assignment permuted with the group-size multiset PRESERVED EXACTLY, so the block has identical width and shrinkage geometry and the only difference is whether the grouping is the truth. If a random grouping does as well, the win is extra regularization, not 'players'.
